title: KIE ground truth
description: Human-validated expected extraction output for one document. The prediction format is identical, which is what makes field-level comparison possible.

document.description: Provenance of the sample. Real-corpus documents are never published; synthetic samples set synthetic: true.

fields.description: Field name to value object. A field that is genuinely absent from the document must be present here with value null — that is what makes a hallucinated value scoreable as a false positive.

value.description: Expected value. null means 'not present in the document'.

required.description: Whether this field is weighted into the required-only aggregate.

confidence.description: Present in model output; in ground truth it is informational only and never scored.

alternatives.description: Equally acceptable values, e.g. a Hungarian tax number in both national and EU VAT form.
